For five years India was the single largest weapons importer on the planet. In February 2026, that flipped. ₹1.39 lakh crore of this year's defence budget is now reserved for Indian companies only, and a whole generation of private players is lining up to take it.
If your defence exposure stops at HAL, BEL and Mazagon Dock, you have invested in the last cycle. The bigger one is happening in private markets, mostly in companies under 10 years old that most public-market investors have never heard of.
